title: The Best Sangria class in Barcelona
text: Kiki’s Sangria class is an absolute must when travelling to Barcelona. Kiki made the class fun, informative, interactive and delicious. Wish we could turn back the calendar and do the class all over again!!
author: nicolehQ4585PZ

title: Kiki and her Sangria workshop are a must!
text:
Kiki was amazing before and during our trip, such a friendly person who wants you to enjoy Barcelona.

We went to the workshop as part of a family hen do. It was fun for all ages and interests. The knowledge was fun and added a competitive edge. The sangria was tasty, we enjoyed the traditional more than the modern. It was so interesting to taste everyone's and see how they were different. We had more sangria than we could drink. The Tapas was also very yummy and different to the other Tapas we had on our stay.  The fancy dress also made for great photos and a playful atmosphere!

This was the
author: CatEvans25

title: Oh Lala Cava Sangria
text:
It was so fun to learn Roman tune and 1960’s Sangria.

Much to my amazement, the cava sangria turned out to be my favorite. 

I will use all the recipes when planning future get- togethers.
author: Laura_L

title: LOVED IT !!!
text: Highly recommend this workshop for a fun night filled with good conversation, delicious sangria, and yummy tapas! Attended this workshop in February 2022 for my friend's 21st birthday, and Zara was FANTASTIC!!!! This was my favorite memory from my trip to Barcelona.
author: noleensmi

title: Fun Sangria Competition!
text: Zara and Kiki did a great job with our group of 35 leaders.  They made us laugh, taught us some history, and provided us with some tapas as well as ingredients to make our own sangria, which was a hit!  We would definitely recommend Savour Academy and hope to get to use them again in the future.
author: morgany123

title: Sangria class does not disappoint!
text: If you would love to learn how to make Sangria and make some new friends in the process, then this is your class and Kiki is your teacher. We really enjoyed making two different versions of the tasty Spanish cocktail. We also fed it on some toppas and enjoyed a little healthy competition. I would highly recommend this class.
author: KathyM2846

title: Had a blast
text: Kiki is an amazing, entertaining, professional and very knowledgeable of the culture of Spain she made the class easy and fun. Made us pay attention on every moment of the class. Learned a lot and she answered questions as not all of us where familiar with European culture. Have been to other different classes but she is totally my number 1 class. Kiki is captivating teacher and charismatic. We all had a great time and enjoyed the competition, laughed a lot that the 2h passed like 2 seconds. Totally recommended her class.
author: Alinaalexa_pgff

title: A fun night with Kiki
text:
What a fabulous evening!
We decided to spend our last evening in Barcelona learning how to make our favorite Spanish beverage.
Little did we know that we were in for such a fun-filled evening of history, laughter and fun! 
Kiki was definitely the ‘hostess with the most-ess’! 
She absolutely made the evening hilarious and enjoyable from beginning to end! 

Additionally, we had some scheduling issues and Kiki accommodated our scheduling needs and communicated easily with quick responses.

A great evening!
author: Stephanie F

title: Amazing class! So much fun!
text: So much fun! Kiki is the most charismatic charming person I’ve ever met! Not I only did I learn how to make original Roman Sangria and modern day sangria, but we dressed up and even made pan con tomate our selves! So authentic and delicious! Kiki is so sweet and funny and knows so much about Barcelona and history. I highly recommend taking this class with some friends or even solo because you’ll make friends there too. Thank you Kiki, for making my Barcelona trip even more special.
author: Yachtmrx

title: A must do!
text:
What a fun evening! 
Kiki was our hostess and she made the evening not only informative, but oh-so fun! 
Can’t wait to go home and make sangria for my friends!
author: Stephanie_F
